title: ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2022
meta_description: The Official Men's T20 World Cup App
full_description: The must-have official tournament app for the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2022! Don't miss a moment of the action as we bring you all the latest news, live scores, match highlights and live in game clips for every match. And now the brand-new VR ShotTracker brings you closer to the action than ever before - see every six through the batter's eyes!Support your team by hitting the favourite button on the app and getting instant notifications to personalise your experience.• BRAND NEW: VR ShotTracker - put yourself in the batter's shoes and see a virtual experience of every six during the ICC Men's T20 World Cup, within seconds of the live action• Be the first to see the action with live in-game clips for every match• A vertical video feed for all the behind-the-scenes action in Australia• Fixtures, results, stats and venue information for every game• Follow your favourite team and get news, video and highlights delivered to you• Multi-lingual Video highlights in English, Hindi, Urdu and Bengali • Dedicated team and player pages for each competing nationDownload now and get ready for the world's greatest cricket celebration!
